searchText: <@!104006934562107392> Does the greeter bot just auto-reply to all new issues and PRs now? I *think* the decision was to have the greeter pipe up on every issue, but not every PR. At the moment, it feels excessive to have it pipe up on every PR but I don't feel particularly strongly about that and I can see myself being convinced otherwise.
